source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.credit: Wikibooks contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Remove the seeds and strings from the squash halves.
Cut a small piece off the outside of each half so it stands level.
Place the halves in a shallow pan with 1/4 inch of water, insides facing down.
Bake for 35 minutes.
Mix 1 tablespoon of marmalade and 1 teaspoon of butter or margarine in a small bowl.
Take the squash out of the oven and turn the halves over in the pan.
Sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon of salt lightly over the squash.
Spread the marmalade mixture on the edges, letting the extra run into the center.
Put the squash under the broiler for 5 minutes, until lightly browned.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Pumpkin Post and Banana Beat Newsletters, University of Massachusetts Extension, Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: mini baguette or Italian bread, about 9 inches long, split lengthwise, or 2 split English muffins
part-skim mozzarella or cheddar cheese, shredded

steps.instruction: Toast the bread until slightly brown.
Top the bread with 1/2 cup of pizza sauce.
Add 1/4 cup of chopped green pepper and 1/4 cup of sliced mushrooms.
Top with 1/2 cup of shredded cheese.
Sprinkle with Italian seasoning, if you like.
Return the bread to a toaster oven, or a regular oven preheated to 350 °F.
Heat until the cheese melts.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Healthy & Delicious: Simple Ways to Low Fat Chinese Cooking, San Francisco Department of Public Health, Chinatown Public Health Center

ingredients.name: apples, cored and quartered, with skin
carrots, peeled and cut into chunks

steps.instruction: Place 1 pound of lean pork, cut into chunks, in a large pot.
Add 4 medium apples, cored and quartered, with the skin on.
Add 4 large carrots, peeled and cut into chunks.
Add 4 slices of ginger and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add 1 teaspoon of dried orange peel if you like.
Pour in 20 cups of water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce to medium heat and simmer until about 8 cups of liquid are left.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat to medium and simmer until the soup cooks down to about 8 cups of liquid. This takes about three to four hours.

steps.instruction: Skim the fat from the surface of the soup.
Store leftover soup covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Eating Smart, Being Active, Colorado State University and University of California at Davis

steps.instruction: Wash the apple, celery and carrots before cutting.
Toss 1 cup of diced apple with 1 teaspoon of lemon juice.
Add 1/2 cup of diced celery, 1/2 cup of grated carrots and 1/2 cup of raisins.
Fold 1/2 cup of low-fat vanilla yogurt into the apple mixture.
Cover the bowl.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.credit: Wikibooks contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0

ingredients.name: stale French or Italian bread, cut into crouton-sized cubes
broad-leaf parsley, chopped, up to 1 bunch

steps.instruction: Mix 1 1/4 cups of milk, 2 eggs and 2 teaspoons of salt together.
Combine the mixture with 9 ounces of bread cubes and the parsley in a large bowl.
Coat as much of the bread as you can with the mixture.
Set the bowl aside while you cook the onion.
Chop 1 medium onion to make 1/4 cup.
Saute the onion in 4 tablespoons of butter.
Let the onion cool enough that it will not cook the eggs.
Add the onion to the bread mixture and mix thoroughly.
Let the mixture rest for 1 hour, mixing it once or twice.
steps.spoken: Let the mixture rest for 1 hour, mixing it through once or twice. You want every cube coated with the liquid on all sides so it soaks up as much as it can. This matters most if your bread is more than a few days old.

steps.instruction: Wet a fresh cotton dishcloth, tea towel or cloth napkin.
Unfold the cloth completely and put the bread mixture in the middle.
Form the bread mixture into a log 3 inches thick.
Roll the log up tightly in the cloth.
Tie off the ends of the cloth with a short piece of string.
steps.spoken: Tie off the ends of the cloth with a short piece of string or twine. Some cooks also tie a string around the middle, because the edge of the cloth tends to pucker there.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, then add salt.
Lower the dumpling slowly into the water and cook for 40 minutes.
Lift the dumpling out of the water with tongs onto a large cutting board.
steps.spoken: Lift the dumpling out of the boiling water with tongs, or two forks if you have to, and put it on a large cutting board.

steps.instruction: Cut off the string, then unroll the cloth and remove it.
Cut 1/2-inch slices, taking only as many as you need so the rest stays hot.

baked-fish-tomatoes-peppers-onions.title: Baked Fish with Tomatoes and Peppers

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from Spicy Baked Fish, Montana State University Extension Service, Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: cod fillets, skinless and thawed, or other white fish

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Cut the 1 pound of cod fillets into four pieces.
Place the cod pieces in the baking dish.
Top the cod with 1/4 cup of chopped green pepper and 1/2 can of tomatoes.
Top with 1/4 cup of chopped onion and 1/4 teaspoon of oregano.
Bake for about 20 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Simple Healthy Recipes, Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education, ONIE Project

ingredients.name: thyme, leaves removed from sprigs and crushed
tilapia fillets, 6 ounces each, or other white fish

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Place 1/3 cup of parmesan cheese and 1 teaspoon of flour in a paper bag.
Add 1 teaspoon of crushed thyme leaves to the bag.
Coat each of the 4 tilapia fillets by shaking it gently in the bag.
Discard the coating ingredients that are left in the bag.
Place the fillets in a baking pan on a rack.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 cup of halved mushroom caps.
Add 1/2 cup of sliced green onions and 1 crushed garlic clove.
Cook, stirring often, until the onions are tender.
Season with ground black pepper.
Serve the baked fish topped with the mushroom mixture.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Spray a baking dish with cooking spray.
Arrange 4 tilapia fillets in the dish so they do not overlap.
steps.spoken: Arrange 4 tilapia fillets in the baking dish. The dish should be large enough that the fillets do not overlap.

steps.instruction: Mix 4 chopped tomatoes, 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 1/2 teaspoons of thyme.
steps.spoken: In a bowl, mix 4 chopped tomatoes, 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 1/2 teaspoons of thyme.

steps.instruction: Mix in 1/4 cup of diced olives and 1/4 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
Mix in 2 cloves of garlic, 1/2 cup of diced red onion and 1 tablespoon of lime juice.
Spoon the tomato mixture evenly over the fillets.
Bake uncovered for 15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
steps.spoken: Bake uncovered for 15 to twenty minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

steps.instruction: Top with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Montana State University Extension Service

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Drain the water from the tofu.
Wrap the tofu in paper towels for 5 minutes.
Mix 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 1 clove of minced garlic in a small bowl.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of minced ginger and 1 teaspoon of oil.
Cut the tofu into slices 1/2 inch thick.
Place the tofu slices on the foil-lined baking sheet.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the tofu.
Gently turn the slices over to coat both sides with the sauce.
steps.spoken: Use a spatula or pancake turner to gently turn the slices over, so both sides are coated with the sauce.

steps.instruction: Bake the tofu for 15 minutes.
Turn the slices over and bake 15 more minutes, until light golden brown and firm.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Texas Cooperative Extension Expanded Nutrition Program, The Texas A&M University System

ingredients.name: chicken breast, skinless, cooked, cut up or shredded

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 450 °F.
Slice the 6 English muffins in half.
Place the muffin halves on a large, ungreased cookie sheet.
Chop 1 bell pepper.
Spread 3/4 cup of barbecue sauce on the muffins, to within 1/4 inch of the edges.
Top the muffins with 1 1/2 cups of cooked chicken breast.
Top with 3/4 cup of shredded cheddar cheese.
Top with the chopped bell pepper.
Bake for 7 minutes, until the cheese is melted.
steps.spoken: Bake for 7 to twelve minutes, until the cheese is melted.

black-bean-and-sweet-potato-quesadillas.title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Quesadillas

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Bronson Wellness Center, Bronson Healthcare - Michigan

ingredients.name: sweet potato, cooked and cut into pieces

steps.instruction: Spray a medium pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 clove of minced garlic and cook until soft.
Add 1 cooked sweet potato, 1 cup of black beans and 1/2 jalapeno pepper.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons each of ground cumin and paprika.
Heat the mixture until just warm.
Spread the mixture over 4 tortillas.
Top with 1/2 cup of baby spinach and 1/4 cup of cheddar cheese.
Top each one with a second tortilla.
Heat a pan on high heat and spray it with nonstick cooking spray.
Brown 1 quesadilla for 1 minute on one side.
steps.spoken: Brown 1 quesadilla for about 1 minute on one side. Then do the same with the other quesadillas, one at a time.

steps.instruction: Flip it and brown 1 minute more, until the cheese is melted.
steps.spoken: Flip it and brown it for about 1 more minute, until the inside is warm and the cheese is melted.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A River of Recipes: Native American Recipes Using Commodity Foods, USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 300 °F.
Line an 8-inch square cake pan with foil.
Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a large pot.
Add 2 cups of blue cornmeal.
Add 1 cup of yellow cornmeal.
Add 3/4 cup of raisins.
Add 1/2 cup of sprouted wheat.
Add 1/3 cup of packed brown sugar.
Stir well until the mixture is smooth.
Pour the mixture into the foil-lined pan.
Cover the pan with a piece of foil.
Bake for 2 hours, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: North Dakota Food and Culture: A Taste of World Cuisine, North Dakota State University Extension Service

steps.instruction: Chop 1 head of cabbage, 2 1/2 large carrots and 3 1/2 large tomatoes.
Chop 3 1/2 large potatoes, 2 medium onions, 2 cloves of garlic and 2 green peppers.
Put 2 1/4 pounds of beef stew meat in a large pot.
Add all the chopped vegetables to the pot.
Add salt and pepper to taste, if you like.
Add enough water to completely cover the mixture.
Add 1/2 tablespoon of vegetable oil and 1/2 tablespoon of vinegar.
Cover and cook on low heat for 2 hours, until everything is well done.
steps.spoken: Cook, covered, on low heat for two to three hours, until everything is well done.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Choices: Steps Toward Health, University of Massachusetts Extension, Nutrition Education Program

steps.instruction: Wash 3 large, firm tomatoes.
Cut the tomatoes in half.
Mix 8 ounces cottage cheese, 1/2 teaspoon dried basil and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Spread the cheese mixture on the tomato halves.
Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of bread crumbs over the tomatoes.
Spray the tomatoes with 2 sprays of cooking spray.
Spray a broiler pan with cooking spray.
Place the tomatoes on the pan.
Broil for about 10 minutes.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.credit: Wikibooks contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0

steps.instruction: Add 1 pound of crabmeat and 1 cup of breadcrumbs to a medium bowl.
Add 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon ground mustard and 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce.
Add 1 egg and salt and pepper to taste, then mix well.
Mix 1 cup mayonnaise, 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and 2 teaspoons capers.
steps.spoken: In a separate bowl, mix 1 cup of mayonnaise, 2 teaspoons of Worcestershire sauce and 2 teaspoons of chopped capers. This is the sauce.

steps.instruction: Mix in 1 teaspoon garlic, the juice of 1 lemon and 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest.
Shape the crab cake mix into 3-inch patties, about 2 per serving.
steps.spoken: Shape the crab cake mix into 3-inch patties, about 2 per serving, or smaller for appetizers.

steps.instruction: Heat 3 cups of vegetable oil in a skillet.
Add the crab cakes to the hot oil.
Flip and cook 3 more minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Flip the crab cakes and cook 3 to four more minutes, until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Remove the crab cakes and drain them on paper towels.
Top the crab cakes with the sauce.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor joel-maxuel

ingredients.name: salt, plus a dash for the sauce
black pepper, plus a dash for the sauce
chicken or skirt steak, bones and skin removed

steps.instruction: Mix 1/4 cup of lime juice, 2 tablespoons of oil and 4 cloves of crushed garlic.
Mix in 2 teaspoons of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of liquid smoke.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.
Add 1 pound of chicken or skirt steak, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
steps.spoken: Add the chicken or steak to the marinade, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.

steps.instruction: Mix 2 tablespoons of water, 1 teaspoon of soy sauce and 1/2 teaspoon of lime juice.
steps.spoken: Mix 2 tablespoons of water, the remaining 1 teaspoon of soy sauce and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of lime juice. Add a dash of salt and a dash of pepper, then set the sauce aside.

steps.instruction: Grill the meat over medium-high heat for 4 minutes on the first side.
steps.spoken: Grill the meat over medium-high heat for 4 to five minutes on the first side.

steps.instruction: Flip the meat and grill for 4 minutes on the other side.
steps.spoken: Flip the meat and grill 4 to five minutes more, until a thermometer reads 165 °F for chicken or 145 °F for steak.

steps.instruction: Cut the meat into thin strips and keep it warm.
Heat the other 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 large sliced onion and 1/2 each of green, red and yellow bell pepper.
steps.spoken: Add the sliced onion and the sliced green, red and yellow bell peppers. Cook until brown.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat and pour the sauce over the onion and peppers.
Toss the meat, onion and peppers together.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Deliciously Healthy Family Meals

steps.instruction: Thread 6 grapes, alternating green and red, onto each wooden skewer.
steps.spoken: Thread 6 grapes onto each 6-inch wooden skewer, alternating the green and red grapes. You will use 48 green and 48 red grapes in all.

steps.instruction: Freeze the skewers for 30 minutes, until frozen.
Serve the grapesicles right away.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.credit: Wikibooks contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 finely chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
Sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Stir in 1 diced green bell pepper and 1 diced red bell pepper.
Cook a few minutes, until the peppers begin to soften.
Add 6 large diced ripe tomatoes.
Add 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon cumin and 1/2 teaspoon coriander.
Add 1/4 teaspoon of ground black pepper.
Stir well to combine.
Pour in 1 cup of water.
Stir in salt to taste.
steps.spoken: Stir in salt to taste. Stir again so the spices are evenly spread.

steps.instruction: Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan.
Cook for 15 minutes, until the tomatoes have softened.
steps.spoken: Cook for 15 to twenty minutes, until the tomatoes have softened and the flavors have blended.

steps.instruction: Taste the sauce and adjust the salt or spices.
Take the saucepan off the heat.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor lsma

steps.instruction: Mince 4 cloves of garlic.
Dice 1 large onion.
Melt 1/4 cup of butter in a pot.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté.
steps.spoken: Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is just beginning to brown.

steps.instruction: Pour in 2 to 3 cups of chicken broth and 2 to 3 cups of crushed tomatoes.
Raise the heat to high.
Cut 1 1/2 pounds of chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes.
Add the chicken to the pot.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of coriander, 1 teaspoon of cumin and 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of ground fennel seeds, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger.
Add 1/4 teaspoon each of mustard and ground cloves.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor herzeleid02

steps.instruction: Add 1 teaspoon of flour to a saucepan.
Pour 1/4 cup of cream into the saucepan.
Stir over high heat.
steps.spoken: Stir the sauce and turn the heat up as high as it goes.

steps.instruction: Keep stirring until the sauce thickens.
steps.spoken: Keep stirring until the sauce thickens. If it is too thin, add more flour. If it is too thick, like uncooked pancake batter, add more cream.

steps.instruction: Stir the sauce into your cooked pasta.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
steps.spoken: Add the chopped onion and the minced garlic. Cook until the onion is soft and clear and smells good.

steps.instruction: Add 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed.
steps.spoken: Add the cubed sweet potatoes and stir them with the onion and garlic for a couple of minutes.

steps.instruction: Pour in 4 cups of vegetable or chicken broth.
steps.spoken: Pour in 4 cups of broth. The sweet potatoes should be fully covered.

steps.instruction: Bring the pot to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are soft.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat and simmer for 15 to twenty minutes, until the sweet potatoes are soft and mash easily with a fork.

steps.instruction: Toast 1 cup of unsalted peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat.
steps.spoken: Toast 1 cup of unsalted peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, until they smell good and are lightly browned.

steps.instruction: Blend the toasted peanuts until smooth, like peanut butter.
steps.spoken: Blend the toasted peanuts in a blender or food processor until smooth like peanut butter. Scrape down the sides a few times.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and let it cool a little.
Mash the sweet potatoes until smooth and creamy.
steps.spoken: Mash the sweet potatoes with a potato masher or the back of a fork until smooth and creamy.

steps.instruction: Put the pot back on low heat.
Stir in the blended peanuts until the soup is thick and creamy.
Stir in 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon coriander and 1/2 teaspoon chile powder.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1 teaspoon of ground cumin, 1 teaspoon of ground coriander and 1/2 teaspoon of chile powder if you like some heat. Stir for a few minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in salt and pepper to taste.
Pour in 1 cup of coconut milk, if you like.
Simmer the soup for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Taste and add more salt, pepper or spices if you like.
Ladle into bowls and top with chopped cilantro or parsley, if you like.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor elias-pahls

steps.instruction: Heat some butter in a large pan over high heat.
Add 1 1/3 pounds of finely sliced beef.
Fry the beef until it starts to lose liquid.
Take the beef out of the pan and set it aside.
Sauté 1 onion in the pan.
Add 9 ounces of finely sliced mushrooms and sauté them.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of flour and mix well.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1 tablespoon of flour and mix well. The flour thickens the sauce, so use it carefully.

steps.instruction: Add 7 fluid ounces of white wine and let it boil.
steps.spoken: Add 7 fluid ounces of white wine and let it boil for a few minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 7 fluid ounces of cream and boil until the sauce is very creamy.
Add the beef back and boil until the beef is warm.
Add 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley and serve.
